clusters.headline: Police recover stolen Renoir, Cezanne and Matisse artworks

members.title: Italian police recover stolen Renoir, Cezanne and Matisse artworks worth millions
Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil

clusters.summary: Italian police have recovered several valuable stolen artworks, including works by Renoir, Cezanne, and Matisse. The recovery involved multiple pieces worth millions of dollars that were previously reported missing. The operation resulted in the return of these significant art treasures.

clusters.headline: Kennedy Center board approves restoring Trump name to building facade

members.title: Kennedy Center aprova volta do nome de Trump à fachada apesar de decisão judicial
Kennedy Center board approves Trump name on facade, renovation plan

clusters.summary: The Kennedy Center's board has approved a plan to restore Donald Trump's name to the building's exterior and move forward with a renovation project. The decision comes despite a prior judicial ruling on the matter.

clusters.headline: Trump says he will declare Strait of Hormuz US territory

members.title: Trump Says Will "Soon" Declare Strait Of Hormuz US Territory
Trump diz que vai declarar Estreito de Ormuz como território dos EUA

clusters.summary: President Trump has stated that he intends to declare the Strait of Hormuz, a strategically important waterway between Iran and Oman, as United States territory. The announcement represents a significant policy position regarding one of the world's most critical shipping routes through which a large portion of global oil passes.
